notes.title: Update Information (210715)
notes.notes:
An update has been released.
--------------------------------

-Minor textual fixes
-Fixed issue in certain versions of MacOS where the game would not run because it was marked as from an unverified developer
-Other minor bug fixes

The launcher file was renamed in the update so should you get a missing file warning when running the update, try restarting Steam and it should point to the right file. We apologize for the inconvenience.
